description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductAttributeService' which specifies methods for managing product attributes within an e-commerce system, including saving, updating, and retrieving product attributes based on various criteria.

classes.name: ProductAttributeService
classes.description: A service interface for managing product attributes in an e-commerce platform, providing methods to save or update attributes and retrieve them based on different identifiers.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product attribute or updates an existing one in the system.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product attributes linked to a specific option ID within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product attributes linked to a specific option value ID within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product attributes associated with a specific product and language.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product attributes corresponding to a list of attribute IDs.
